Este es probablemente el último video que suba a este canal.

The ending especially moved me, and I had a small vision which I surprisingly managed to execute quite swiftly. it's probably my 2nd smallest level so far, though I believe one of my more artistic works and I am proud of what I've made. I had a lot of fun as well, though I fear about the reception a lot, since I don't typically show off this genre of levels publicly. 

Give Requiem a listen, it's such an incredible album

A little late to the third anniversary but better late than never. TOTC was always the black sheep on the TM channel to me. I started this project in February under the name 'Thin Line'. Initially, it was intended to be one of several low-effort releases on my birthday (4 August), but I quickly became attached to the idea of entering it into the Duality Gauntlet Contest. With Middle Window, I have tried to portray real life and its regular ups and downs.

The level begins with a glass prism, which symbolises how something as dull as white light can transform into a captivating display of colour. In case it wasn't already clear, I tried to associate the monochromatic palette (black and white) with negative feelings, while the colours represent the joy and happiness that we always need. 

The second section features a substantial element: the Eye, which represents how others and you perceive yourself. We sometimes allow the thoughts of others and ourselves to in...

When I first started this level, I was just making it for fun. I didn't have a release date in mind or even know when I'd finish it. As I kept working on it little by little, a friend was watching me build it and said, Why don't you make it for Duality? I replied, Nah, why would I? haha. Then he answered, Come on, it has that duality in the decoration. I thought about it and said, Alright, I'll give it a try.

Creating with limitations can often lead to some incredibly memorable experiences. Made with entirely 2.0 restrictions, "Princess Demon" by BreadKing, is an outstanding entry for the Duality Gauntlet contest. I can’t believe I actually finished this.

This level took 9 months to create, and those were probably some of the hardest months of my life. I went through all of it alongside this level, and I’m insanely happy that it’s finally over.

This level became my hardest mental challenge in the game. At one point, I just started to hate everything about it — my close friends can confirm that. I would rage at the game, tilt constantly, and sometimes I even felt like crying whenever I opened the editor.

I present to you my best solo — Steel Bloom n Rain.

A little about the level.

The entire level is packed with local references. There are tons of different graffiti pieces scattered throughout it, referencing my friends who supported me throughout this entire journey.

9982.desc:
Hello everyone! I know that many of you were not expecting me to release a new level today, so surprise!!! This level was originally meant to be a low effort project made for my brothers, but as always, I accidentally spent a lot of time on it lol. Surprisingly, this level actually has around the same amount of in-editor hours as my other level 'Touch the Orbs Bub." This style of level is actually so hard to make, and making this level made me gain a lot of respect for other levels that use default blocks in ways that feel uniquely like Geometry Dash. (Ocean of Fish, Dino Level, etc.)
